passage: the prediction formula does not say on how many bits the sum is computed
what_the_text_says: The text gives the formula and says that the shift is arithmetic. It does not say the width of the sum, and no limit of section 9 bounds the predictors.
what_it_affects: The state of the frames of a file whose predictors satisfy (|a| + |b| + 12 |c|) * 32767 + 512 >= 2^31: an exact sum and a sum wrapped on 32 bits give two states there, and the text does not say which one is that of the encoder.
put_to_the_test: Not tested, and not testable on the files read: the sum fits in 32 bits there with a margin of a factor 21.3 to 21.6 (calculation on the predictors, column prediction_margin_32_bits). The reader counts the sums that leave 32 bits: none.

passage: the first node of the support is not named, nor the exact sense of the threshold of the proximity bit
what_the_text_says: The text says to subtract the value of the first node of the support without saying which one it is; elsewhere it gives the nodes of the support in order and the traversal order of the reader. It does not say whether the threshold of 2^14 is strict.
reading_adopted: The node of smallest indices on the three axes, first in the order given in 6.7; in reading by differences it is subtracted everywhere, without testing the bit.
what_it_affects: The field of a file read by differences, where the range of the differences of a support reaches 2^15. Testing the bit or not, strict threshold or not: same integers in every case (reasoning on the text).
put_to_the_test: Tested on c3_d3_eps0005.psi, read by differences: 118 probe points have a support whose range reaches 2^15. The reading adopted gives back the field of the encoder to 5.6e-6 u'; subtracting the last node of the support would give 0.42 u', and the direct reading 25.7 u'. The reading adopted before the trial was the right one; no other was tried in order to choose.

passage: does the frequency table of an empty segment sum to 4096
what_the_text_says: The text requires a sum of 4096 for every table, without exception. The doubt was about the exactness of this sentence for a fine level without a brick, two segments of which are empty.
reading_adopted: The letter of the text: all the tables are checked.
what_it_affects: The wrongful refusal of a valid frame, if the letter of the text had been wrong.
put_to_the_test: Tested on c1_d2_no_brick.psi and c1_d3_no_brick.psi, 72 frames without a brick: all read, the letter of the text is exact.

passage: the fate of a malformed exception in an altered file
what_the_text_says: The text does not say what the reader does with an escape whose position is outside the frame, with a value outside the range of the state, nor with an entry whose bit 31 is zero placed after an overflow.
reading_adopted: Position outside the frame: entry ignored. Value out of range: truncated to the type of the state. Misplaced entry: ignored.
what_it_affects: The outcome of the reading of an altered file only. A valid file has none of these entries: they are sorted, and the encoder writes only states within the range.
put_to_the_test: Not tested: the 84 altered files have the same outcome as with psi_stream play, but I do not know whether one of them carries such an entry; the reader met in them no escape whose position is outside the frame.

passage: an innovation of type 1 placed just after a key
what_the_text_says: The text itself says that such a file has no defined decoding and that pack writes none.
reading_adopted: In sequential reading, the content of the slot, as the text describes it; refusal at position 1, where this content does not exist.
what_it_affects: Nothing: the text has no gap, it declares the case undefined.

passage: "under the maxima of FineInfo": less than or equal, or strictly less
what_the_text_says: The word admits both senses; the definition of the maxima in section 3 leaves only one, since at least one frame reaches each maximum.
what_it_affects: Nothing: only one reading is consistent with the text.
put_to_the_test: The 17 PSISTRM3 files of the criterion are accepted; each has by definition a frame that reaches the maximum.
